prompt:
1. 화창한 오후에 한 남자가 홀로 걷도 있다. 
2. 그의 눈으로 보는 시점으로 앞쪽에 엄청난 사람들 500명쯤이 이쪽으로 달려오고 있다.
3. 화들짝 놀라서 뒤를 돌아 도망간다. 이때 시점은 멀어지면서 3인칭 시점으로 수백명의 사람들 뒤로 거대 공룡이 쫒아오고 있다.
4. 남자의 주머니 클로즈업. 거기에 고양이 츄르가 있다. 
5. 남자가 당당히 서서 츄르를 들고 공룡과 맞선다.
6. 공룡에게 한입에 잡아 먹히면서 끝.

breakdown.logline: A man walking alone on a sunny afternoon flees an approaching crowd and the giant dinosaur behind them, then boldly confronts the dinosaur to soothe it with a cat treat from his pocket, only to be eaten in one bite.

beats.summary: The man walks alone along an empty pedestrian boulevard, showing a peaceful everyday routine.
From the man's point of view, a crowd of approximately 500 people is revealed running toward him.
The man turns and runs away, and a retreating viewpoint reveals a giant dinosaur chasing the crowd.
A cat treat stick in the man's pocket is revealed, suggesting an unexpected means of responding.
The man stops fleeing and boldly faces the dinosaur, holding out the treat stick.
The dinosaur eats the man, treat and all, in one bite.

subjects.name: 남자
subjects.appearance: Tall and slim, wearing a waist-length light-gray jacket, slim dark-gray trousers, medium-gray sneakers, and a dark bucket hat with a wide brim.
signature_features: Long, slender limbs and a hat silhouette that spreads widely relative to his body are distinguishable from any direction, and there is a large flapless pocket on the lower right side of his jacket.

subjects.name: 피난 군중
subjects.appearance: Various heights and body types, wearing modern everyday clothing in a mixture of light through dark grays, densely gathered without bags or large belongings.
signature_features: The broad, dense mass formed by hundreds of people and the irregularly overlapping silhouettes of heads and shoulders maintain an overwhelming scale from any direction.

subjects.name: 거대 공룡
subjects.appearance: Approximately 12 meters tall, with rough dark medium-gray skin, an enormous head and thick torso, stout hind legs, very short forelegs, and a long, thick tail.
signature_features: Its unusually large rounded head relative to its body and its massive build are identifiable from any direction, with low, rounded bumps running along the upper line of its back and tail.

subjects.name: 고양이 간식 스틱
subjects.kind: Small package of squeezable cat treat
subjects.appearance: A flat medium-gray package longer than a palm, with two light horizontal bands and broad sealed borders at both ends.
signature_features: Its long, narrow stick proportions and widened silhouettes at both ends are distinctive, and a simple drawing of a cat's face appears on the front.
